## Recruited by Cipher Pol

Cipher Pol recruits from the Marines' best. A Recruitment Officer waits in some Marine bases for Commanders willing to leave the Navy behind.

Join the World Government. Carriers of the Will of D. are never accepted.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Reverse Mountain](03_paradise.md#q-3521a27cc33d4e78)

**Tasks**

- Join the World Government

**Rewards**

- Doriki +360, Belly +15,000, Loyalty +1

<a id="q-30dadfbe6712799f"></a>

## CP9

Rob Lucci spent five years as a shipwright in Water 7 waiting for one blueprint.

Defeat twenty revolutionaries and belong to a crew. Crews are open to every faction.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Recruited by Cipher Pol](f_world_government.md#q-36dea5fef18580b5)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 20 revolutionaries
- Belong to a crew (/crew create &lt;name&gt;, or accept an invite)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, Loyalty +2

## Gate of Justice

Enies Lobby is the World Government's court. Pirates keep trying to burn it down.

Defeat twenty-five pirates on Enies Lobby, and hold Enies Lobby, Marineford or the Gate of Hell for your crew.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [CP0](f_world_government.md#q-48e2359fd784d12e)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 25 pirates on Enies Lobby
- Own Enies Lobby, Marineford or the Gate of Hell (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500, +1 Training Points (your style), Loyalty +3

## Holy Knight

The Holy Knights hunt those with bounties over a million and stand guard over the Holy Land.

Reach the rank of Holy Knight and defeat two players with a bounty of at least 50,000,000.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [God's Blade](f_world_government.md#q-7d6b9d25627fad58)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Holy Knight
- Defeat 2 players with a bounty of 50,000,000+

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Loyalty +2, Holy Knight Chestplate

## The Five Elders

The Gorosei decide which islands exist and which are erased. They are also older than they look.

Reach the rank of Gorosei and obtain one of the founders' weapons.

Reward: one of the Five Elders' fruits, picked from a chat menu (/fruitreward). Each goes to the first to pick it. Taking one rules out the King of the World's fruit.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Holy Knight Commander](f_world_government.md#q-2bb0b4f34d953431)

**Tasks**

- Rank: Gorosei
- Obtain a founders' weapon

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +200,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Loyalty +2
- Choose a Gorosei fruit: Itsumade, Bakotsu, Gyuki, Feng Xi or Sand Wyrm (first come, first served)

<a id="q-42743bde37a8a12f"></a>

## The Empty Throne

Officially, nobody sits on the Empty Throne in Pangaea Castle.

Reach the rank of King of the World.

Reward: the Akuma no Mi, for the first King of the World alone (not for one who took a Gorosei fruit).

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Five Elders](f_world_government.md#q-6baad0514a52263d)

**Tasks**

- Rank: King of the World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +400,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box
- The Akuma no Mi (the first King of the World only)
